turns.patient_response: Yes, to calm down I end up going back to the same outlet or panel five or ten times—flipping breakers, tugging on wires, and re-reading the code book under my breath. I have to do it until I feel this physical 'click' in my chest that tells me it's safe. If it doesn't feel just right, I have to restart the whole thing from the beginning, even if it makes me late or forces me to walk away from the job entirely.

symptom_reasoning.S065: The patient describes persistent, intrusive doubts and urges regarding safety and things feeling 'just right' that drive their repetitive actions.
symptom_reasoning.S066: The patient performs repetitive checking and repeating rituals, such as flipping breakers and re-reading code books multiple times, to reduce anxiety and feel safe.
